items.title: Elon Musk has lost his lawsuit against Sam Altman and OpenAI
items.raw_content:
Hacker News score: 1097 points, 595 comments | linked site: techcrunch.com | submitted by nycdatasci

Article description: Elon Musk's claim that he was mistreated by his OpenAI co-founders failed after nine California jurors decided in a unanimous verdict that his lawsuits had been filed too late.
items.title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克起诉 Sam Altman 与 OpenAI 败诉
items.summary: A nine-juror California panel unanimously found that Elon Musk's claims of being mistreated by his OpenAI co-founders were filed too late, ending his lawsuit. The TechCrunch report drew 1,097 points and 595 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Italy moves to Airbus A330 tankers
items.raw_content:
Hacker News score: 284 points, 126 comments | linked site: euronews.com | submitted by embedding-shape

Article description: Rome shifts course: six Airbus A330 MRTT tanker aircraft, worth around €1.39 billion in total, to bolster the European pillar in NATO. #EuropeNews
items.title_zh: 意大利转向采购空客 A330 加油机
items.summary: Euronews report, discussed on Hacker News (284 points, 126 comments), that Rome will buy six Airbus A330 MRTT tanker aircraft worth about €1.39 billion, shifting course to strengthen the European pillar within NATO.

items.title: Star Citizen game has reached $1B in funding
items.raw_content:
Hacker News score: 35 points, 18 comments | linked site: robertsspaceindustries.com | submitted by speckx

Article description: Roberts Space Industries is the official go-to website for all news  about Star Citizen and Squadron 42. It also hosts the online store for game items and merch, as well as all the community tools used by our fans.
items.title_zh: 《星际公民》众筹金额已达 10 亿美元
items.summary: Roberts Space Industries' funding tracker, shared on Hacker News (35 points, 18 comments), showing the crowd-funded space sim Star Citizen has passed $1 billion in total funding.

items.title: OpenAI to confidentially file for IPO as soon as Friday
items.raw_content:
Hacker News score: 137 points, 3 comments | linked site: cnbc.com | submitted by doppp

Article description: OpenAI is working with banks including Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley.
items.title_zh: OpenAI 最早将于周五秘密提交 IPO 申请
items.summary: Hacker News discussion (137 points, 3 comments) of a CNBC report that OpenAI plans to confidentially file for an IPO as soon as Friday, working with banks including Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley.

items.title: Minnesota becomes first state to ban prediction markets
items.raw_content:
Hacker News score: 785 points, 245 comments | linked site: npr.org | submitted by ortusdux

Article description: While dozens of states have taken legal action against the controversial industry, Minnesota is the first state to pass a law making it a felony for companies like Kalshi and Polymarket to operate.
items.title_zh: 明尼苏达州成为首个禁止预测市场的州
items.summary: NPR report that Minnesota became the first US state to pass a law making it a felony for companies such as Kalshi and Polymarket to operate prediction markets, after legal action by dozens of other states. 785 points, 245 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Anthropic acquires Stainless
items.title_zh: Anthropic 收购 Stainless
items.summary: Anthropic has acquired Stainless, a builder of SDK and MCP server tooling, to strengthen Claude's ability to connect to external data and tools. The Hacker News submission drew 531 points and 382 comments.

items.title: The FBI Wants to Buy Nationwide Access to License Plate Readers
items.title_zh: FBI 希望购买全国车牌识别器数据的访问权
items.summary: 404 Media reports that the FBI wants to buy nationwide access to license plate reader data, a contract only a couple of vendors, likely Flock and Motorola, could fulfil. The story drew 338 points and 146 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Mini Shai-Hulud Strikes Again: 314 npm Packages Compromised
items.title_zh: Mini Shai-Hulud 再度来袭：314 个 npm 包被入侵
items.summary: SafeDep report that a compromised npm maintainer account published 637 malicious versions across 317 packages, including size-sensor, echarts-for-react and timeago.js; the Hacker News thread drew 391 points and 313 comments.

items.title: GitHub confirms breach of 3,800 repos via malicious VSCode extension
items.title_zh: GitHub 确认：恶意 VSCode 扩展导致 3800 个仓库被入侵
items.summary: GitHub has confirmed that roughly 3,800 internal repositories were breached after one of its employees installed a malicious VS Code extension; the story drew 1,054 points and 460 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Tennessee man jailed 37 days for Trump meme wins settlement after lawsuit
items.title_zh: 田纳西州男子因特朗普表情包被关押 37 天，诉讼后获和解
items.summary: FIRE reports that retired Tennessee law-enforcement officer Larry Bushart won a settlement from the county and sheriff behind his 37-day jailing over a Trump meme; the story drew 768 points and 515 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: The memory shortage is causing a repricing of consumer electronics
items.title_zh: 内存短缺正在引发消费电子产品重新定价
items.summary: An essay on how the global memory crunch is driving a repricing of consumer electronics, including cheap smartphones, drawing 544 points and 653 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Project Glasswing: An Initial Update
items.title_zh: Project Glasswing：初步进展更新
items.summary: Anthropic published an initial update on what the company has learned from Project Glasswing, its research effort, drawing 561 points and 325 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Didgeridoo playing as alternative treatment for obstructive sleep apnoea (2006)
items.title_zh: 演奏迪吉里杜管作为阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停的替代疗法（2006）
items.summary: A 2006 study in a PubMed Central journal testing whether didgeridoo playing reduces upper-airway collapsibility and daytime sleepiness in people with moderate obstructive sleep apnoea and snoring; 341 points on Hacker News.

items.title: Spanish court declines to fine NordVPN over LaLiga piracy blocking order
items.title_zh: 西班牙法院拒绝就 LaLiga 盗版封锁令对 NordVPN 罚款
items.summary: TorrentFreak reports that after a Spanish court ordered VPN providers to block pirate football streams, the same court declined to fine NordVPN for non-compliance; the Hacker News thread drew 225 points and 121 comments.

items.title: Claude is not your architect. Stop letting it pretend
items.title_zh: Claude 不是你的架构师，别再让它假装是
items.summary: Essay arguing AI agents are effective implementers but confidently wrong on the architectural decisions that matter, urging developers not to hand Claude design authority; 275 points and 190 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Why is Vivado 2026.1 dropping Linux support for free tier?
items.title_zh: Vivado 2026.1 为何取消免费版的 Linux 支持？
items.summary: AMD support-forum thread, discussed on Hacker News (409 points, 233 comments), asking why Vivado 2026.1 is dropping Linux support for the free tier.

items.title: I’ve joined Anthropic
items.title_zh: 我加入了 Anthropic
items.summary: Andrej Karpathy announced on X that he has joined Anthropic to return to frontier LLM research and development, saying he remains deeply passionate about education and plans to resume that work in time. 1,431 points and 618 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Bun support is now limited and deprecated
items.title_zh: Bun 支持现已受限并弃用
items.summary: A yt-dlp issue thread that drew 594 points and 608 comments on Hacker News announces that support for Bun as an ejs-compatible JavaScript runtime is being both limited and deprecated due to foreseeable compatibility and security issues.

items.title: Microsoft reports AI is more expensive than paying human employees
items.title_zh: 微软报告称 AI 比雇人更贵
items.summary: Fortune report, discussed on Hacker News (229 points, 71 comments), on Microsoft finding AI can cost more than paying human employees, with bills rising as more staff use the technology.

items.title: BambuStudio has been violating PrusaSlicer AGPL license since their fork
items.title_zh: BambuStudio 自 fork 以来一直违反 PrusaSlicer 的 AGPL 许可证
items.summary: A GitHub write-up documents alleged AGPL violations in BambuStudio since its fork from PrusaSlicer, gathering links to Josef Prusa's public warning and Tom's Hardware coverage. The Hacker News thread drew 105 points and 42 comments.

items.title: Reverse engineering Android malware from popular Chinese projectors
items.title_zh: 逆向分析中国产热门投影仪中的 Android 恶意软件
items.summary: A blogger pointed an autonomous coding agent at a $35 Chinese-made projector and reverse-engineered the Android malware it found, including a large remote access trojan. The post drew 89 points and 19 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Deep – CLI/REPL for generating and iterating on codebases using DeepSeek
items.title_zh: Deep：用 DeepSeek 生成和迭代代码库的 CLI/REPL
items.summary: Front-page Hacker News post (24 points, 0 comments) linking to Deep, a command-line tool and REPL for generating and iterating on codebases using DeepSeek, whose repository carries no further description.

items.title: Show HN: Lance – image/video generation and understanding in one model
items.title_zh: Lance：集图像/视频生成与理解于一体的统一模型
items.summary: ByteDance research repo for Lance, a 3B-active-parameter native unified multimodal model covering image and video understanding, generation and editing, trained on fewer than 128 GPUs; the Show HN post drew 64 points and 15 comments.

items.title: DeepSeek makes the V4 Pro price discount permanent
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 将 V4 Pro 价格折扣永久化
items.summary: Front-page Hacker News discussion (621 points, 549 comments) of DeepSeek's notice that deepseek-v4-pro API pricing becomes a quarter of its original price after the 75% discount promotion ends on 2026/05/31.

items.title: DeepSeek reasonix, DeepSeek native coding agent with high caching and low cost
items.title_zh: DeepSeek Reasonix：高缓存、低成本的 DeepSeek 原生编程智能体
items.summary: MIT-licensed open-source coding agent that runs locally in the terminal, desktop app, browser or editor, reading projects, editing files and running commands with rewindable edits; 729 points and 288 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: DeepSeek to Make Permanent 75% Discount on Flagship AI Model
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 将把旗舰 AI 模型的 75% 折扣永久化
items.summary: Bloomberg report, discussed on Hacker News (209 points), that DeepSeek will make its 75% discount on its flagship AI model permanent.

items.title: Doorman11991/smallcode
items.title_zh: Doorman11991/smallcode：为小参数模型优化的 AI 编程智能体
items.summary: An AI coding agent optimized for small language models, claiming 87% on an unspecified benchmark with a 4B-active-parameter model. The JavaScript project has 2,028 GitHub stars and 153 forks.

items.title: MobiusQuant/OpenMobius-skill
items.title_zh: MobiusQuant/OpenMobius-skill
items.summary: A Python ICT/SMC trading-knowledge skill for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw and Hermes; the repository has 714 stars and 61 forks.

items.title: simonlin1212/global-stock-data
items.title_zh: simonlin1212/global-stock-data
items.summary: GitHub Trending toolkit (1,775 stars, 258 forks) packaging US and global market data for AI coding assistants: 16 data layers, 50+ endpoints and 17 official zero-auth sources, each tagged with a compliance tier.

items.title: akitaonrails/ai-memory
items.title_zh: akitaonrails/ai-memory
items.summary: akitaonrails/ai-memory is a Rust project providing long-term memory for agent coding CLIs and easing handoff between different agent vendors; it has 13,548 stars and 960 forks on GitHub.

items.title: Silo-Server/silo-server
items.title_zh: Silo：自托管的媒体流媒体服务器
items.summary: Go and React GitHub project (751 stars, 93 forks) for Silo, a self-hosted media streaming server with a Go backend, React web UI, Docker deployment, transcoding and Jellyfin-compatible APIs.

items.title: study8677/awesome-architecture
items.title_zh: awesome-architecture：架构优先的系统设计教程合集
items.summary: Vue-based GitHub collection (2,468 stars, 279 forks) of 26 bilingual tutorials, 25 architecture templates and six end-to-end cases covering distributed systems, AI-native systems, RAG and coding agents.

items.title: akitaonrails/ai-usagebar
items.title_zh: ai-usagebar：监控各家 AI 套餐额度的 Rust waybar 组件
items.summary: Rust-based waybar widget that monitors plan status and credits for Claude, GPT, GLM and OpenRouter, inspired by claudebar and codexbar; 724 stars and 171 forks on GitHub.

items.title: xm486/YukiHub
items.title_zh: YukiHub：Android 平台的 Galgame 管理工具
items.summary: GPL-3.0 Android app written in Java for managing Galgame visual novels, supporting synchronization of local games, shortcuts and play records; 550 stars and 18 forks on GitHub.

items.title: uu201/character-arc
items.title_zh: CharacterArc（弧光）：AI 小说创作应用
items.summary: Cross-platform TypeScript AI fiction-writing app combining project settings, character relationships, plot outlines, chapter drafting and multi-model AI collaboration; 591 stars and 84 forks on GitHub.

items.title: DexJoCo: A Benchmark and Toolkit for Task-Oriented Dexterous Manipulation on MuJoCo
items.title_zh: DexJoCo：基于 MuJoCo 的面向任务灵巧操作基准与工具包
items.summary: DexJoCo is a MuJoCo benchmark and toolkit of 11 dexterous manipulation tasks covering tool use, bimanual coordination, long-horizon execution and reasoning, with a low-cost data collection system and 1.1K trajectories. Its GitHub repository has 235 stars.

items.title: GoLongRL: Capability-Oriented Long Context Reinforcement Learning with Multitask Alignment
items.title_zh: GoLongRL：面向能力的长上下文强化学习与多任务对齐
items.summary: Fully open-source long-context RLVR recipe (58 upvotes) releasing a 23K-sample dataset, the construction pipeline and all training code across nine task types; a Qwen3-30B-A3B model trained on it matches DeepSeek-R1-0528 on long-context work.

items.title: Sensor2Sensor: Cross-Embodiment Sensor Conversion for Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: Sensor2Sensor：面向自动驾驶的跨车型传感器转换
items.summary: Google researchers propose Sensor2Sensor, a diffusion-based paradigm that converts in-the-wild monocular dashcam video into multi-modal AV logs with multi-view camera images and LiDAR point clouds, trained on real AV logs rendered into dashcam-style video via 4D Gaussian Splatting.

items.title: RT-Splatting: Joint Reflection-Transmission Modeling with Gaussian Splatting
items.title_zh: RT-Splatting：高斯泼溅下的反射—透射联合建模
items.summary: Peking University paper (7 upvotes) presenting RT-Splatting, which separates each Gaussian's geometric occupancy from optical opacity to render semi-transparent specular surfaces with sharp reflections and clear transmission in real time.

items.title: Auditing Agent Harness Safety
items.title_zh: 审查智能体执行框架的安全性
items.summary: UCSB's HarnessAudit evaluates full agent execution trajectories, not just final answers, across boundary compliance, execution fidelity and system stability. Testing ten harness configurations on a 210-task benchmark, it found task completion often diverges from safe execution and that multi-agent setups widen the risk surface.

items.title: AtlasVA: Self-Evolving Visual Skill Memory for Teacher-Free VLM Agents
items.title_zh: AtlasVA：面向无教师 VLM 智能体的自演化视觉技能记忆
items.summary: Paper proposing AtlasVA, a teacher-free visual skill memory framework that organizes memory into spatial heatmaps, visual exemplars and symbolic text skills to improve spatial decision-making for VLM agents on long-horizon tasks. 28 Hugging Face upvotes; code at 77 stars.

items.title: Matérn Noise for Triangulation-Agnostic Flow Matching on Meshes
items.title_zh: 用于网格上三角剖分无关流匹配的 Matérn 噪声
items.summary: Paper (5 upvotes) adapting flow matching to signals on triangle meshes with a triangulation-agnostic noise distribution built from Matérn processes and a PoissonNet denoiser, demonstrated on meshes above one million triangles.

items.title: You Only Need Minimal RLVR Training: Extrapolating LLMs via Rank-1 Trajectories
items.title_zh: 只需极少量 RLVR 训练：通过秩一轨迹外推 LLM
items.summary: Researchers find RLVR weight trajectories are extremely low-rank, letting their RELEX method extrapolate checkpoints by linear regression from a short observation window; on three Qwen models it matches full RLVR with 15% of the steps.

items.title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
items.title_zh: WorldKV：高效世界记忆与检索压缩
items.summary: KAIST AI's WorldKV is a training-free framework that stores evicted KV-cache chunks and retrieves scene-relevant ones by camera or action correspondence, adding token pruning to match full-KV fidelity at roughly 2x throughput on video world models.

items.title: CiteVQA: Benchmarking Evidence Attribution for Trustworthy Document Intelligence
items.title_zh: CiteVQA：为可信文档智能建立证据归因基准
items.summary: CiteVQA is an OpenDataLab benchmark of 1,897 questions over 711 PDFs that requires document models to return element-level bounding-box citations alongside each answer. Auditing 20 MLLMs exposed widespread attribution hallucination, with the best system, Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview, reaching 76.0 strict attributed accuracy.
